# ARC // CTO
**Plain-English Tech Advisory, Practical AI, and Part-Time Tech Leadership for Small Business**
**Website:** https://www.arccto.com

## About Us
ARC // CTO is built on 26 years of hands-on experience in the low-voltage, security, and IT integration industry. We give small businesses the same caliber of tech advice that mid-to-large commercial clients pay $300/hour for — without the agency overhead, buzzwords, or sales pitch. We work with business owners the way they actually want to communicate: chat, text, and email first, with voice or video available when it's genuinely useful.

## Core Services
* **Consulting:** Unbiased tech and vendor advice — reviewing quotes, auditing systems, and answering questions on physical security, low-voltage systems, and IT vendors trying to overcharge you.
* **Training:** Getting more from the software and AI tools you already pay for (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Google Workspace/Gemini) instead of buying something new.
* **Operations:** Custom workflows, estimating tools, and part-time/fractional technical executive partnership for businesses that need ongoing oversight but not a full-time hire.
* **MCA:** Our AI assistant, available on the site, for quick questions and initial discovery — no phone call required.

## Self-Guided Guide
**Ground Truth: Quarterly Checkup** — $19 printable guide. Four plain-English pages, one per quarter, covering logins & access, software & subscriptions, vendor contracts, and backups — the things that quietly cost small businesses the most. Available at https://arccto.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/cb82235c-ed75-45e6-b777-0d342d90e0e8

## Engagement Model
We start every relationship with a free 30-minute discovery conversation (chat, email, voice, or video — your choice), no cost and no sales pitch. From there:
* **1-Hour Advisory Session:** $150 flat rate
* **8-Hour Advisory Block:** $960, usable within 30 days
* **Custom Operations Retainers:** Scoped and priced to the business, discussed after discovery
